name: dbml-translator
description: DBML schemas explained to non-developers, gap analysis against product specs, and Mermaid ERD rendering.

interface.shortDescription: Translate DBML schemas, diff them against product specs, and render Mermaid ERDs
interface.longDescription: Three skills for DBML workflows: dbml-explain turns a DBML schema into PM-readable narrative (entities, relations, enums, scenarios), dbml-spec-diff compares a DBML schema against a PRD/기획서 to surface missing entities, drift, and cardinality conflicts, and dbml-to-mermaid converts DBML into a Mermaid erDiagram block ready to embed in Confluence or README.
defaultPrompt: Explain this DBML schema to a non-technical stakeholder
Compare this DBML schema against the product spec and find gaps
Render this DBML as a Mermaid erDiagram for Confluence
